emily: Heads-up — a large healthcare customer asked for explicit audit-event validation + signed evidence bundles for RBAC/KMS activity. They want proofs within 48h and SLA credits if evidence incomplete. cc @carmen

raj: Can we map their asks to our current coverage? Quick brain-dump: role_grant, role_revoke, role_update, key_rotation, key_access(read), kms_unseal, policy_change. We currently emit role changes and key_rotation, but key_access (read) is not tracked separately — that's the gap here.

carmen: From compliance side: for HIPAA/BAA and FedRAMP-like audits they expect tamper-evident logs and chain-of-custody. Signed tarballs + hash chain ok, but they often insist on customer-verifiable signatures (BYOK) for final bundles. Also retention windows and export proofs need to be contractually guaranteed.

mike: Infra note: we already have an export-signing pipeline for SOC2 reports. Questions: do we need per-tenant signing with customer KMS (BYOK) or can platform-sign + publish verification steps suffice? BYOK will increase complexity (rotation, access controls).

emily: They explicitly asked for customer KMS-backed signing so auditors can independently verify. Also want schema changes to include caller identity and pre/post state for RBAC events. They provided an example snippet — pasted here for clarity:

```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T22:11:00Z",
  "event": "role_grant",
  "actor": {"id": "u-1234", "type": "human", "principal": "alice@cust.com"},
  "resource": {"id": "proj-42", "type": "project"},
  "prev_state": {"roles": []},
  "new_state": {"roles": ["admin"]},
  "auth_context": {"kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abc", "session_id": "s-9876"},
  "signed_digest": "sha256:..."
}
```

raj: We should add these fields to the canonical audit schema: event.action, actor.id, actor.type, actor.principal, resource.id, resource.type, prev_state, new_state, auth_context.kms_key_id, signed_digest, and optionally handler/service. Also propose admin-level actions be logged at 100% sampling and flagged for immediate bundle inclusion.

security-bot: export-signing job started for tenant: cust-health-01 at 2026-03-19T18:22:31Z (job-id: exp-20260319-001) :gear:

carmen: Legal perspective: platform-signing alone may not satisfy some auditors. We can offer a dual approach: platform-signed bundles for convenience + optional customer BYOK signing step for final audit artifacts. Need to confirm KMS integration scope and who handles key custody/legal obligations.

sara: Legal: we should push back on mandatory 48h contractual SLA for signed bundles. Suggest proposing 7 days standard, with 48h expedited as an enterprise add-on (fee + implementation window). Also need explicit clauses about evidence completeness, force majeure, and requirement for customer to provide necessary context/data.

mike: Implementation estimate: ~3 sprints to (1) add schema fields and backfill parsers, (2) extend export pipeline to attach signed_digest and support per-tenant key wrapping, (3) add retention config + signed-bundle workflow. Risks: KMS BYOK brings HSM/KMS integration work, rotation handling, per-tenant key access auditing.

raj: Action items I/O: 1) inventory missing audit events (role/key/auth) and post results by EOD, 2) prototype per-tenant signing design (flow diagram + threat model), 3) sync with legal on contract language draft. I'll grep logs and assemble missing-event list.

emily: Thanks. I'll collect follow-up Qs for the customer: exact event types they need, retention period (months/years), cert format (PEM vs CMS), whether they require streaming SIEM feed in addition to signed bundles.

(threads end)
